label: Kirchhoff–Love and Mindlin–Reissner plates
text: EN.O.A1.2.5 Kirchhoff–Love plate and Mindlin–Reissner plate. Kirchhoff–Love applies to thin plates with normals staying normal; Mindlin–Reissner admits transverse shear for moderately thick plates.
